agentic_error_rate_definition: HIGH-impact reference-word mass over total reference words. A HIGH substitution or deletion charges the reference tokens it covers; a HIGH insertion charges one reference-word-equivalent at its anchor. Same denominator as the corpus WER, so the two are comparable point for point. Spans classified format-convention, reference-convention or segmentation-artifact are NONE by ruling; the strict variant re-admits segmentation-artifact.

fold_authorities.format-convention/merge-compound: Open ASR Leaderboard `merge_compounds`, which the published ESB column applies and this study does not
fold_authorities.format-convention/numeric-equal: the Whisper `EnglishTextNormalizer`'s number rules; the residue is digits that agree with a different surface form around them
fold_authorities.format-convention/stray-punctuation-toke: NO PUBLISHED AUTHORITY, but no published recipe treats a token with zero alphanumeric characters as a word either: these are Rev's ellipsis marks surviving the normalizer as bare `.` / `..` tokens. Reported separately for the same reason
fold_authorities.format-convention/symbol-only: NO PUBLISHED AUTHORITY. The Whisper normalizer deliberately KEEPS `.%$` and the currency signs, so `$340` against `340` is a difference the recipe intends to preserve. Reported inside the scoring-convention bin so it can be subtracted, never claimed as an existing convention
fold_authorities.format-convention/whisper-refold: the Whisper `EnglishTextNormalizer`'s own rules, applied a second time over the span in isolation
fold_authorities.reference-convention/empty-reference: the ESB protocol: a reference that normalizes to nothing contributes no denominator, and the leaderboard's own recipe drops such rows

refused_folds.reference-convention/discourse-phrase: no authority removes 'you know' / 'I mean' from a reference
refused_folds.reference-convention/discourse-single: these tokens are ordinary words as often as they are fillers; folding them would silently delete content
refused_folds.reference-convention/false-start-stem: no published normalizer removes Rev's truncated-word stems; folding them would be this study inventing a convention to improve its own number
refused_folds.reference-convention/filler-token: the Whisper normalizer's filler list is exactly hmm|mm|mhm|mmm|uh|um; extending it is a new convention, not an existing one
refused_folds.reference-convention/reference-repetitio: the 2026-09-05 A/B verdict already measured that collapsing repeats makes the number WORSE, and no ESB or leaderboard rule collapses them
refused_folds.segmentation-artifact/neighbour-bleed: the ESB protocol scores each published utterance against its own sentence; crediting a neighbour's words would change the task, not the scoring
